Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic CXMS (Cross-linking Mass Spectrometry) study using EDC. While not a traditional 'enrichment' for a PTM, the use of EDC to map protein-protein interactions (Ska complex to tubulin) routes this to a complexome/structural proteomics workflow. Acquisition is DDA based on the 'Top 8' selection logic described.

scope: The protein complexes were purified by affinity chromatography in batch mode using glutathione sepharose (GE Healthcare) beads.

Crosslinking experiments were carried out using a zero-length crosslinking agent, EDC (Thermo Fisher Scientific) in the presence of N-hydroxysulphosuccinimide (Thermo Fisher Scientific). Ska complex (6 μM) and 10 μM MTs were incubated

The bands corresponding to crosslinked complexes were excised and the proteins therein were reduced... alkylated... and digested using 13 ng μl−1 trypsin... The digested peptides were desalted using C18-Stage-Tips and analysed on a LTQ Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by mass spectrometry consisted of recombinant Ska complex and microtubules, which were purified via affinity chromatography and subsequently crosslinked and isolated via SDS-PAGE gel excision.

evidence: By combining X-ray crystallography, crosslinking/mass spectrometry (MS) and biochemistry, we have here characterized the MTBD of the human Ska complex and evaluated its interaction with MTs in vitro and in vivo.

Crosslinking experiments were carried out using a zero-length crosslinking agent, EDC (Thermo Fisher Scientific) in the presence of N-hydroxysulphosuccinimide (Thermo Fisher Scientific). Ska complex (6µM) and 10µM MTs were incubated with 10µg EDC and 22µg N-hydroxysulphosuccinimide in a final volume of 20µl. The reaction mixture was incubated for 90 min at 25°C
The reactions were resolved by SDS–PAGE (4–12% Bis-Tris NuPAGE, Invitrogen) gel separation and stained using Instant Blue (Expedeon). The bands corresponding to crosslinked complexes were excised

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics component of this study is a structural characterization using cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) to map interaction sites between the Ska complex and microtubules. It is not a differential expression or perturbation study; therefore, it is mapped as 'un-classified'. The EDC is a chemical reagent used for the assay (cross-linking), not a biological perturbation variable.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a structural proteomics experiment using CXMS to map interactions between the Ska complex and tubulin. Standard LFQ workflows are not the primary goal; the critical requirement is a cross-link search engine (like Xi or similar) capable of identifying EDC-mediated K-E/D linkages.
